name: exa-deep-research
description: Exa semantic web search, page fetching, filtered search and optional managed research through four native tools.
scope: Companion tool capability for existing research workflows. Sends user queries/URLs to the official Exa service; no local-file ingestion. Search/fetch support anonymous quota. Managed research requires EXA_API_KEY and explicit approval. No model, subagents, keys or Node runtime bundled.
